photo_details_for_worst.caption: Topo diagram 'LOW BULGE' (16M wall, 10M right side) with 3 bolt anchor (star) and routes A 6b, B 6a, C 5b, D (grade not marked). Inset photo of the boulder wall bottom right. Notes: wall is two large boulders stacked; significant rope drag; climbs similar to boulder problems with crux harder than the rest; best before 1130.

Composite layout: small crag photo (dark overhanging crack with rope) plus bullets 'Easy crack climb that is always in the shade / Difficult face climb / Need to abseil or lower from bolt near ladder to anchor point to set up', beside a drawn topo titled 'SHADY CRACK' (16M scale). Topo shows routes A1 (4), A2 (5b, 'Many variations'), B (6c), with 1-bolt and 2-bolt anchors marked. Crag attribution unverified (adjacent to Mek's Mountain pages, so possibly that crag).

Drawn topo titled 'Eagle Wall' (14M scale). Routes left to right: Easy Eagle (4), Moguls (5c), I got a feeling (6a, 6a+ variation), Clear Horizons (5a), 2 Step (5c), Charly's Crack (6a). Bolt counts noted: Moguls 5 bolts, I got a feeling 5 bolts, Clear Horizons 5 bolts, Charly's Crack 5 bolts. Anchors: 'Fixed 3 Bolt Anchor', '3 bolt TR anchor', 'Top out and use hanging anchor'. Notes: first wall used for guides and courses; training wall; 'Charly's Crack' and 'I got a feeling' are the two classic climbs; best from 1400 onwards.

Photo-topo titled 'The Watchtower': tall boulder/rock tower with two dashed lines - 'Holy Exposure!' (6a) to a starred anchor at the summit, and 'The Kiddie Slope' (4). Notes: 'Stringer to fixed anchor, please be careful and use tape to affix rope'; 'Great climb!'; 'Please be careful getting to and at the base of the climb as a fall will be deadly'; 'One of the best views of Koh Tao from the top'. Crag unverified (same guidebook section as Mek's Mountain pages; nearby 'Pow, Right in the Baby Maker' mentions views over Sairee).

Large drawn multi-pitch topo. Upper section labeled 'The Watchtower' with '2 bolt Anchor' and 'South Abseil' (17m scale). Route 'Pow, Right in the Baby Maker': P1 5b, 18m, 6 bolts, 1 sling, 2 bolt anchor ('squeezing through the eerie flake at the 4th bolt; use an extender draw on 6th bolt'); P2 5c, 17m, 7 bolts, 2 bolt anchor ('face climbing into a chimney; amazing views over Sairee and some decent exposure'). Also shows 'Lower Fraggle' sector (18m) with sling anchor. Boxed text block 'Multipitch Climbing' safety notes (helmets, loose rock, climbing calls, go with experienced partner). Crag unverified (The Watchtower links it to the p11 Watchtower topo; 'views over Sairee' suggests Mek's Mountain area).

Drawn topo titled 'DE-VINE WALL' with two inset photos. Routes (left to right): Mosquito Burrito 6a, Devine Intervention 6a+, Dirty Squirrel (by 'Tree'), Daddy Long Legs 6a, Tim and Charly's only Friend 4+ (4 bolts), Squirming Worm, Bees Knees (4 bolts), Arabian Balls 6a. Notes: 'Bolts only', '12M' height scale, 'Start in chimney and switch to boulder at top', 'training anchor'. Which of the 9 known crags this wall belongs to is unverified.

Drawn topo titled 'QUIT YOUR'E BITCHIN' with two inset photos. Routes (left to right): Naughty or Nice (Chimney), C U Next Tuesday 5c, Son of a bitch 7a (2 bolt anchor), an unlabeled 6c+ line (1 bolt anchor backup), The bitch in me 6c (2 bolt anchor). Notes: 'Anchor approach is to the rear and care should be taken', 'Best before 1230', 'Naughty or Nice is a classic which can be face climbed or chimneyed. Great views at the top', '16M' height scale. Crag identity unverified; 'The bitch in me 6c' matches a known classic route.

Photo-topo titled 'The Elephant – North Side' with compass rose. Dashed route lines with star anchor. Route list at bottom: '6. MH', '7. E', '8. MH', '9. The Wet Beaver 4', '10. H', '11. The Trunk 7a'. Beach, longtail boats and buildings visible.

Hand-drawn bouldering area map titled 'The Frontyard', labeled 'Tantoe Bay / Aow Leuk' (Tanote Bay). Shows ~60 numbered boulders. Legible route/problem names: The Lost Idol V8, Jungle Science V9, Mantle V6, Predator V7. Landmarks: Big Brother, Mini-crag, Hill Top, Cave, Small Stream, Park Here, The Backyard, Chalok Baan Kao, Mae Haad, Koh Tao Info, several 'Bldg' icons, compass rose. 'Distance not to scale' note.

Detailed hand-drawn bouldering map of the Secret Garden boulder field. Header: 'Upper Secret Garden (see separate map)'. Legible problem/boulder names: James and the Giant Peach V11, Pancake Ninja V6/VH, Jawa Ship, Under Frondly Fire V4, Super pinch, Exploding epitaph; landmarks: Jawa Ship, Stacking boxes, Court yard, spaceship, Nose, The egg, The Tombstone, letter box, JP Guest house, Jungle, Park Here, Up Hill, Barbed wire fence / Concrete wall, several 'Bldg' icons. Boulder problems annotated with difficulty codes (VE, E, M, MH, H, VH) and 'High ball' notes. Compass rose marked 'Z' (north arrow), 25m scale bar.

Top-down map titled 'Upper Secret Garden' with compass rose (N/E) and 25m scale. Legible labels: 'Dense Jungle', 'To Star Villa and Buddha Temple' (uphill), 'Hill Top', 'Water Tank', 'Bldg' (several buildings), 'Please be considerate with noise when close to bungalows', 'Secret Garden (see separate map)', Downhill/Uphill arrows. Boulder problems marked with grades: 'MH / V1 Groovy', 'H / V7 (project)' (twice), 'H / V2 (project)', 'E / MH / V0', 'VE - Kit Kat, MH / V2', 'H / V7 (project)', 'MH / V1 - I just need a hug', 'H / MH / V3 - Chiropractor', 'MH / V3 - Shadows', 'James and the Giant Peach - V11', 'Under Friendly Fire V4', 'Jawa Ship', 'High ball', 'Pancake Ninja V6 / VH'. Grade letters H/MH/E/VE appear to be quality/star markers alongside V-grades.

Topo diagram titled 'The Peak Boulders' at June Jua Beach (area not among the 9 known crags - crag unverified). Boulder layout with letter/grade labels: MH - Pete's arete, Pro, M, M, Pro, MH - Nak Lung Noi, M - Kanom Wan, H - Crimpology, E - Baseball mantle, MH - Long live the Buddha, *M, MH - Slinky, MH, E, E, *E Sit. Landmarks: Viewpoint of Chalok Baan Kao, The Castle, steep sandy/rocky road. Compass rose.

Topo diagram titled 'Sai Tong area' (near Jansom Bay per map labels). Boulder layout near Small Coral Beach, Sai Tong beach, Jansom Bay; features a 'Cave'. Labels: H - Return of the Jeddi, M/MH/H/E difficulty markers, M - Hels's arete (partially legible). Compass rose. Area attribution per the PDF page text: the page covers both The Peak Boulders and the Sai Tong area; the exact placement of this topo is inferred, unverified.

Full guidebook page "Aow Luek": intro text (beach, snorkelling, warning about grumpy local) plus hand-drawn boulder topo with numbered problems and route list: 1. **Wonderlust V0 (great slab), 2. **V0 (traverse right from #1), 3. ***The Naturalist V4, 4. ***Naturalist Extension V4, 5. *Boop Boop Chomp V2, 6. **Rhythm Splitter V4 (crack and face), 7. **Clam Sandwich V1, 8. *V0, 9. *Caluga V0, 10. *V4 (sit start on low flake), 11. **Fish Supper V2. Credit: "Maps and problems by Matt Pierson, July 2010". Aow Luek is a beach adjacent to Lang Khai Bay but is not one of the 9 main crags, so crag is null.

Full guidebook page "Lang Khaai Bay": intro text (secluded seaside granite, Tantalis roof, Yang's Bungalows, potential DWS/cliff-jumping spot toward Tanote bay), compass rose and hand-drawn topo with 12 numbered problems: 1. ***Planet Paradise V4, 2. ***Tantalis V6 (traverse right along break, crank through jugs), 3. ***Pinatubo V4, 4. *Hairy Classic Right V2 (splitter crack), 5. *Hairy Classic Left V3 (vertical break), 6. ***Zenalithic V2, 7. **Difensless V3 (arete), 8. *V1, 9. *V1, 10. *Seafluzy V4, 11. ***Infra-bubba V2, 12. *V0. Credit: "Maps and problems by Matt Pierson, July 2010".

Sketch topo page "Sai Daeng High Balls": text warns of VERY dangerous highball bouldering with bad landings ("Not recommended for the feint of heart!!!"); access is a 5-minute boulder hop left from the Coral View Resort; views of Shark Island. Hand-drawn boulder map with compass rose and grades marked V0, V1, V2 and "VE" (unusual grade label, as printed), plus "(+down climb)" and "P" markers. No route names given.

Climber in helmet on a sea cliff of stacked granite blocks above turquoise water; ropes/gear visible at base. No route names legible. Crag unverified (sea-cliff setting, possibly Tanote Bay or Lang Khai area).
